assertions.name: two-scenarios-recorded
assertions.detail: Baseline and controlled worker-loss scenarios must both be recorded.

assertions.name: baseline:at-least-twelve-tasks
assertions.detail: Each scenario must contain at least twelve isolated reference tasks.

assertions.name: baseline:ten-active-or-post
assertions.detail: At least ten cards must be observed in active or post-processing state together.

assertions.name: baseline:slot-decisions-complete
assertions.detail: Every coding, gate, and review execution needs a recorded admission decision.

assertions.name: baseline:multi-worker-execution
assertions.detail: Coding, gates, and reviews must each use more than one worker.

assertions.name: baseline:isolated-workspaces
assertions.detail: Workspace paths must be unique and disposable gate/review roots must be removed.

assertions.name: baseline:exact-result-sha
assertions.detail: Every gate and review must execute at its declared Result SHA.

assertions.name: baseline:delivery-idempotent
assertions.detail: Result handoff and completion must replay idempotently.

assertions.name: baseline:review-idempotent
assertions.detail: Review verdict replay must retain one authoritative passing report.

assertions.name: baseline:integration-deterministic
assertions.detail: Integration must complete in stable task ordinal order.

assertions.name: baseline:no-cross-task-commits
assertions.detail: No result range may contain a commit attributed to another task.

assertions.name: baseline:no-product-failures
assertions.detail: Environmental pressure or worker loss must not be counted as product failure.

assertions.name: baseline:telemetry-present
assertions.detail: Resource pressure and slot occupancy telemetry must be present.

assertions.name: baseline:queues-drained
assertions.detail: No queue item may be lost, duplicated, or left pending.

assertions.name: baseline:authority-audit-clear
assertions.detail: Audit sequences must be unique, authority actions drained, and Studio must execute no work.
